text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kinko Sho. Today's rival, 
Matikanefukukitaru, arrives loaded with 
all sorts of good-luck charms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by Mihono Bourbon, she now calls 
herself "Full Armor Fukukitaru," 
apparently. ...Yeah, I'm not letting her 
do that.
